title: Capability Exposure Accounting for Threshold-Based Encrypted Backup Recovery: research artifact
description: Release 4.1.13 of the research artifact and manuscript for "Capability Exposure Accounting for Threshold-Based Encrypted Backup Recovery" (Samarjeet Malik, Shaurya Pratap Singh), the version the authors are submitting for publication. Manuscript version 4.1.13 simplifies Figs. 2 and 6 of version 4.1.12, a figures and presentation pass in which the introduction is built around a running example, the full proofs of the composition theorem (now Theorem 24; Theorem 25 up to version 4.1.11) and of the erasure and committee results move to the supplement Online Resource 1 (manuscript/supplement.tex), notation is unified and the figures read in grayscale; the body is 34 pages. Results are unchanged since version 4.1.1. A pinned container (Dockerfile) is built and run by a GitHub Actions workflow (all checks pass with docker run --init). The artifact code (artifact/) is byte-identical to version 4.1.1 (10.5281/zenodo.24060229), which reproduces every result; artifact/reproduce_all.py reruns all checks. The composition theorem is restricted-adaptive (guessing factor L, exponential in renewed generations), not fully adaptive. No physical erasure, refinement proof or production readiness is claimed. Source: https://github.com/SamarjeetMalik/threshold-backup-capability-accounting (tag v4.1.13). Previous version: 10.5281/zenodo.24091781 (v4.1.12).
notes: Code and artifact (artifact/) under MIT; the manuscript, figures and plot data under CC BY 4.0. Springer class and style files keep their upstream terms.
